provenance.note: MMR sewage-treatment points: capacities/utilisation from the MPCB per-STP inventory; the 9 BMC plants carry per-STP inlet/outlet BOD from Praja 2024 Table 13 (RTI series, 2020-2024); the 5 eastern-corridor plant locations are OSM. CAUTION: the top-level `sources` key is the facility payload, not citations - per-record `source` strings carry the per-claim citations.

source: MPCB per-STP inventory (STP_information_on_website_publication) + Praja Foundation 'Status of Civic Issues in Mumbai 2024', Table 13 (RTI-obtained per-STP inlet/outlet BOD & TSS, 2020-2024). Capacities/utilisation from MPCB; treatment performance from the Praja/RTI series. Eastern-corridor (non-BMC) plant locations from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Discharge BOD compared against the 10 mg/l discharge standard.
_note: Sewage treatment points across the MMR. The 9 MCGM (BMC) plants carry per-STP inlet/outlet BOD from the Praja 2024 RTI series - four (Versova, Bhandup, Ghatkopar, Malad) consistently fail the discharge standard; Malad effectively does not treat (2023 outlet BOD 140.6 vs inlet 144.2). The 5 eastern-corridor plants (Thane/Navi-Mumbai/Panvel) are added with OSM locations and operator/discharge facts only: there is no public per-STP BOD series for the non-BMC corporations equivalent to Praja's BMC table, so their treatment-performance cells are an honest gap. Locations are approximate facility centroids.

sources.name: Malad STP
sources.description: 280 MLD plant discharging to Malad Creek. Effectively non-functional as a treatment works: 2023 outlet BOD 140.6 mg/l against an inlet of 144.2 - i.e. almost no treatment - and 99.4 in 2024, far above the 10 mg/l discharge standard. A 454 MLD replacement is proposed.

sources.name: Versova STP
sources.description: 180 MLD plant. Outlet BOD 53.4 (2023) and 58.1 (2024) mg/l against inlet ~143-146 - well above the 10 mg/l standard. A 180 MLD next-generation plant is proposed.

sources.name: Ghatkopar STP
sources.description: 386 MLD plant discharging toward Thane Creek. Outlet BOD 38.0 (2023) and 24.5 (2024) mg/l - above the 10 mg/l standard. A 337 MLD replacement is proposed.

sources.name: Bhandup STP
sources.description: 280 MLD plant discharging toward Thane Creek. Outlet BOD 30.4 (2023) and 20.7 (2024) mg/l - above the 10 mg/l standard. A 215 MLD replacement is proposed.

sources.name: Worli STP (Love Grove)
sources.description: 757 MLD - Mumbai's largest STP, discharging via the Worli outfall. Compliant: outlet BOD ~1.9 mg/l (2023) against inlet ~124. A 500 MLD next-generation plant is proposed. Offline in 2024 for MSDP-2 reconstruction (500 MLD next-generation plant).

sources.name: Bandra STP (Bandra/Mahim influent)
sources.description: 797 MLD influent works discharging to Mahim Bay. Compliant: outlet BOD ~2.1 mg/l (2023) against inlet ~81-116. A 360 MLD next-generation plant is proposed. Offline in 2024 for MSDP-2 reconstruction (360 MLD next-generation plant).

sources.name: Colaba STP
sources.description: 41 MLD plant. Compliant: outlet BOD 1.3 (2023), 5.0 (2024) mg/l against inlet ~121-131.

sources.name: Charkop STP
sources.description: 6 MLD plant near Marve Creek. Compliant despite very high inlet load: outlet BOD ~3.1 (2023), 5.4 (2024) mg/l against inlet 181-214.

sources.name: Powai WSP (waste stabilisation pond)
sources.description: 8 MLD waste-stabilisation pond near Powai, at the head of the Mithi catchment. Small relative to the ~18 MLD of untreated sewage entering Powai Lake.

sources.name: Kopri STP (Thane)
sources.description: TMC's sewage treatment works at Kopri, on the western shore of Thane Creek - the receiving water for much of the eastern corridor's sewage (a 2025 review estimated ~1,260 MLD of domestic sewage reaching the creek, with BOD above the CPCB limit in all samples). Per-STP inlet/outlet performance is not published in a Praja-equivalent series.
sources.source: OpenStreetMap (location); Thane Creek WQ review 2025 (creek sewage load)

sources.name: NMMC STP (Koparkhairane side)
sources.description: One node of NMMC's sewage-treatment network discharging treated effluent toward Thane Creek. Navi Mumbai reports among the higher treatment coverage in the MMR (a multi-plant network of roughly 450 MLD installed). Per-STP BOD performance is not in a public RTI series.

sources.name: NMMC STP (Vashi/Nerul side)
sources.description: A southern node of NMMC's STP network discharging toward Thane Creek, part of the roughly 450 MLD installed across Navi Mumbai's plants.

sources.name: Mumbra WWTP (Thane)
sources.description: Wastewater works at Mumbra, on the Kalwa/Ulhas side of the eastern corridor where the Ulhas system meets Thane Creek. Per-STP performance is not publicly reported.

sources.name: Taloja WWTP (Panvel node)
sources.description: Wastewater plant at the Taloja node south-east of Navi Mumbai. The adjoining Taloja MIDC industrial cluster discharges to the Kasadi river, a documented MPCB/CPCB pollution concern, making this a mixed domestic + industrial pressure point on the eastern fringe.
sources.source: OpenStreetMap (location); MPCB/CPCB Kasadi river pollution record
